summary: Inventory screen for any game: owned items by rarity with category tabs and item cards.
description: A ready inventory for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit. It shows what the player owns from the SDK's cached inventory (no request of its own): category tabs (equipment, consumables, other), rarity frames, counts and levels, and an item card popup with the description. Equipment hands off to the heroes screen (ctx.features.open('character', { itemInstanceID })) and a chest or key item to the chests screen (ctx.features.open('lootboxes', { itemID })) when those systems are installed. Registers the 'inventory' feature — always shown in the lobby, even before the title has items.
provides: hand-off of equipment to the heroes screen
hand-off of chests and keys to the chests screen
